== Summary ==
Original Japanese printing of [[Commander Luke Skywalker (Japanese)]], from the Japanese Limited [[Hoth (Japanese)]] edition. Extracted unchanged from the original embedded image on p. 43 of the collecting encyclopedia.<ref name="hoth-japanese-face">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>

Source PDF SHA256: <code style="white-space:normal;overflow-wrap:anywhere">07bb3a1fbdd1a65f6cafdff1fca821108ff8210c82da70a10b988ea7539d1665</code>. Embedded image xref: 2058. Original image SHA256: <code style="white-space:normal;overflow-wrap:anywhere">d94c729e80e10db1dd6855302dc69b9d0885a8157d0a1064564c338d8198ee84</code>. No resizing, cropping, retouching or reconstruction.

Copyright text on the card credits Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1998. The image documents the historical card printing.
